# David Perla featured in CDR discussing the legal finance industry and its critics


January 22, 2025


-
-
-
-


Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) is featured in CDR discussing the legal finance industry and its critics.


Perla discusses how legal finance has entered the mainstream, as well as how industry criticism may have increased its popularity in a time where litigation costs are rising dramatically.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.cdr-news.com/categories/third-party-finance/quarterly-focus-third-party-funding-faces-its-critics/)
